## Use in this project

The application icon, installer artwork, splash mark, Start Center mark, and About
mark use this glyph. The SVG path geometry is used unchanged. This project only:

- rasterizes the SVG to PNG/ICO at the required sizes;
- changes the fill color to the Chenyi Office palette;
- places the glyph next to product text.

No icon shape is drawn or invented by this project.
